description: 车透视让路，后透视将死
explanation_en: A rook sacrifice clears the queen's X-ray line and leads to checkmate.

intro.popup: 💡 透视攻击：白后在c2，透视穿越白车h4，沿对角线直指h7。白方如何弃车引出透视将死？
intro.popup_en: 💡 X-ray attack: White's queen on c2 aims along the diagonal through its rook on h4 toward h7. How can White sacrifice the rook to reveal the mating attack?

outro.popup: ✅ 要点：Rxh7+弃车！象吃车，白后透视白车的原来路线，Qxh7将死！
outro.popup_en: ✅ Key idea: Sacrifice with Rxh7+ to draw the bishop onto h7. The rook clears the queen's X-ray line, allowing Qxh7#.

moves.popup: 白车弃子Rxh7+！车从h4攻h7将军，强迫黑象吃车，让白后的透视对角线完全畅通！
moves.popup_en: Rxh7+! The rook sacrifices itself with check, forcing the bishop to capture it and fully opening the queen's X-ray diagonal.

moves.popup: 黑象被迫吃车，落在h7——正好成为白后的新攻击目标。
moves.popup_en: The bishop is forced to capture the rook on h7, landing directly on the queen's target square.

moves.popup: 透视攻击将死！白后c2早已透视白车h4盯住h7，白车移走后白后直取h7将死黑王！
moves.popup_en: X-ray checkmate! White's queen on c2 was aiming through the rook on h4 at h7. Once the rook moves, Qxh7# mates the black king.
